name: Kgolo Mmogo culturally tailored support group intervention
product_description: A six-month, culturally tailored support-group programme developed by Eloff and colleagues for HIV-positive mothers and their 6–10-year-old children in South African communities, delivered through separate and joint weekly sessions with trained, supervised community care workers.
